name: Expunge raises the Necromancer's disease damage by 10% per stack, up to 2 stacks (#529)
contract: The Expunge talent 705754 (CharacterAdvancement 34982, Death tab) reads "Casting Command spells on an enemy now applies Expunge if they are Diseased." and embeds 500343's Description: "Increases the target's damage taken from your Necromancer diseases by $573233s1% for $573233d, stacking $573233u times." 500343 is the tooltip carrier (Rank "Talent", 999 Runic Power, no CharacterAdvancement row); the applied debuff is 573233: SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER with EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10, effect 0 EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0x800000, 0x20) inside SpellFamilyName 29, which covers Flesh to Worms 500338 (family flags 0x4000, 0, 0x20), SpellDuration 1 = 10000 ms, StackAmount 2. The talent casts the trigger 500443 on the Command target; 500443 carries TargetAuraSpell 802913 (Plagued), which nothing on this server applies (its applier 806457 has no acquisition), so SpellInfo::CheckTarget refused every Expunge and 573233 never landed. Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken multiplies the caster's matching MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER amount, and the amount scales with stacks, so the Necromancer's Flesh to Worms is taken at x1.10 after one Command and x1.20 after two, and a third Command keeps two stacks. Command: Skeletal Mage's own frost bolt 801513 (family flags 0x100000, 0, 0) is not a disease and stays at x1.00. Only AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp's disease-gated cast may apply 573233, once per Expunge: 500443's own effect 2 (SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL 573233) runs in the launch phase, which the script's hit-phase PreventHitDefaultEffect does not stop, so it would add an ungated second stack; a Command against an enemy without the Necromancer's disease applies nothing.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Expunge talent is active
Raise a Skeletal Mage to command
SETUP: the Skeletal Mage is raised
Command against an enemy that is not diseased
Let an Expunge application resolve
CONTROL: no Expunge without the Necromancer's disease
Let the global cooldown pass
Disease the golem
SETUP: the golem carries Flesh to Worms
Let the global cooldown pass
First Command
DISCRIMINATING: a Command on the diseased golem applies Expunge
One stack raises disease damage taken by 10%
Expunge lasts 10 sec
Let the global cooldown pass
Second Command
The second Command adds a stack
Two stacks raise disease damage taken by 20%
A non-disease Necromancer spell is not increased
Let the global cooldown pass
Third Command
Let a third application resolve
Expunge stacks only 2 times
